data.title: Ebola disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: Since May 2026, an Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus has been ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/ebola-outb.label: Ebola disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo

data.title: ECDC deploys experts to DRC to increase support amidst ongoing Ebola outbreak
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: With the Ebola disease situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) still critical, the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) is deploying experts to DRC to increase support at the epicentre of the outbreak.

https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-event.label: ECDC deploys experts to DRC to increase support amidst ongoing Ebola outbreak

data.title: Postcard from the field: Supporting outbreak preparedness in South Sudan - two EPIET fellows in the field
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: In July and August, two fellows from ECDC’s long-standing European Programme for Intervention Epidemiology Training (EPIET) were deployed to South Sudan through the EU Health Task Force (EUHTF) and WHO’s Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN), to support the country’s Ebola preparedness and strengthen surveillance.

https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-event.label: Postcard from the field: Supporting outbreak preparedness in South Sudan - two EPIET fellows in the field

data.title: MERS-CoV worldwide overview
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: Summary Since the beginning of 2026, and as of 31 August 2026, two MERS cases, including one fatality, have been reported in Saudi Arabia.

data.title: World Mosquito Day 2026: Europe must upgrade control tools as disease risks rise
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: Europe needs to improve its preparedness and control efforts as the risk of mosquito-borne diseases increases, with West Nile virus (WNV) continuing to spread to new regions and invasive mosquito species becoming established in more parts of Europe.

https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/news-event.label: World Mosquito Day 2026: Europe must upgrade control tools as disease risks rise

data.author: ECDC

data.title: Chikungunya virus disease worldwide overview
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: Every month ECDC provides detailed epidemiological overview of the worldwide transmission of chikungunya virus disease in its weekly threat report (Communicable Diseases Threat Report).

data.title: Risk to general population remains very low following fourth imported Ebola case in Europe
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: A healthcare worker from Europe based in the DRC who tested positive for Bundibugyo virus on 29 September has been medically evacuated to receive specialised care.

data.title: EU-led assessment to Albania will strengthen cross-sector response to antimicrobial resistance
data.author: ECDC
data.summary: An EU-led mission of experts to Albania this week will identify priority gaps, define areas for further action and support the strengthening of national responses to antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in the country.
